The project sites are GitHub and Read the Docs. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/src/seed_scan/cli.py

The claude account in the contributors graph comes from Co-Authored-By trailers on AI-assisted commits. giacomocaironi and pmazzocchi, the other organization owners, administer every repository and have made no commit here. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#continuity https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/graphs/contributors
code_of_conduct_justification: btclib-org/.github's CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md is this repository's code of conduct, through GitHub's organization-wide default; the community-profile API reports it. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
code_review_standards_justification: REVIEWING.md states what a review checks, how a finding is written and what clears a pull request; the part shared by every repository is followed by what this tree checks in particular. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/REVIEWING.md
coding_standards_enforced_justification: ruff-check, ruff-format and mypy run as pre-commit hooks, and lint.yml runs the same .pre-commit-config.yaml in CI as a required check, so the style is enforced automatically rather than by review alone. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml
coding_standards_justification: pyproject.toml selects every ruff rule (select = ["ALL"]) with a documented ignore list, and runs mypy in strict mode. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/pyproject.toml
contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md states the public-surface, refusal, lint-gate and 100%-coverage requirements a contribution must meet before it can land. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contributors_unassociated_justification: fametrano is the only significant contributor: every commit on main is fametrano's but one Dependabot update, counted with git log origin/main --format=%an | sort | uniq -c. giacomocaironi and pmazzocchi, the other organization owners, have made no commit here. https://github.com/fametrano
copyright_per_file_justification: Every Python file opens with "Copyright (c) The btclib developers", and ruff's flake8-copyright rule (CPY001) keeps it there, e.g. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/src/seed_scan/__init__.py
crypto_algorithm_agility_justification: The algorithms are fixed by the mnemonic schemes the command reads, BIP32 derivation and each coin's address format, so a user cannot switch to another without leaving the scheme that made the wallet. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/README.md#identifying-a-mnemonic
crypto_call_justification: seed-scan implements no cryptographic primitive. It calls hashlib's sha256 and the ssl module from the standard library, and takes the mnemonic schemes, the derivation and the addresses from bip39-slip39, bip32-descriptors, btclib-wallet, coin-addresses and btclib, the packages built for them; git grep -E 'hmac|pbkdf|ecdsa|keccak|secp|scrypt|ripemd' -- src/ finds nothing. bundle.py decodes Base58Check itself, an encoding whose checksum it takes from hashlib's sha256. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/pyproject.toml
crypto_certificate_verification_justific: Certificate verification is on by default, and no option turns it off. The context of the Electrum server scan and forks ask is ssl.create_default_context, which requires a certificate chaining to a trusted CA and naming the host, against the system's CA certificates or those of the file --cafile names alone (cli._tls_context). The Ethereum node over https is verified against the system's CA certificates and must name the host (seed_scan.evm). tests/scan_cli_test.py asserts CERT_REQUIRED and check_hostname on every Electrum context, and refuses a server or a node whose certificate does not verify. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/src/seed_scan/cli.py
crypto_credential_agility_justification: seed-scan supports no file for a credential or a private key, by design: the mnemonic and the passphrases, from which every key is derived, are read at a hidden prompt alone, and cli.py refuses to read them from an argument, a file, standard input or the environment, so that a secret never rests where the process list, the shell's history or the disk keep it. It writes only to standard output and standard error, and reads the files the user names and the system's CA certificates: ssl.create_default_context() for the Electrum server without --cafile, and load_default_certs() in the node's context. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/src/seed_scan/cli.py
crypto_floss_justification: Every cryptographic function it uses is FLOSS: CPython's hashlib and ssl over OpenSSL, and the MIT-licensed btclib-org packages it depends on, with pyca/cryptography beneath btclib-wallet. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/pyproject.toml
crypto_keylength_justification: The keys it derives are fixed by their schemes, secp256k1 keys of 256 bits, and the hash it calls is SHA-256. TLS takes CPython's default context, which refuses TLS below 1.2 and offers no cipher below 128-bit strength (get_ciphers, measured 2026-11-14). No option selects a shorter key. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/src/seed_scan/cli.py
crypto_password_storage_justification: seed-scan stores no password and authenticates no user. A BIP39 passphrase typed at the prompt is used to derive a seed and never stored.
crypto_pfs_justification: The only key agreement is TLS's, and every cipher CPython's default TLS client context offers agrees keys with ECDHE or DHE, or is TLS 1.3's, which is always ephemeral (ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_CLIENT).get_ciphers(), measured 2026-11-14).
crypto_published_justification: Every algorithm is a published one: SHA-256 (FIPS 180-4), the BIP39, SLIP-0039 and Electrum mnemonic schemes, BIP32 derivation on secp256k1, and TLS 1.2 and 1.3. identify's tests run a vector its authors publish for each scheme it reads (tests/no_secret_test.py). https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/README.md#identifying-a-mnemonic
crypto_random_justification: seed-scan generates no key and no nonce of its own: nothing under src/ imports random or secrets or reads os.urandom. The keys and nonces of its TLS connections are OpenSSL's, drawn from OpenSSL's CSPRNG. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/src/seed_scan/
crypto_tls12_justification: Every TLS connection requires TLS 1.2 at least. The Electrum context scan and forks share sets minimum_version to TLSv1_2 (cli._tls_context), which tests/scan_cli_test.py asserts. The node's context is an ssl.SSLContext(PROTOCOL_TLS_CLIENT), whose minimum is TLS 1.2 on CPython 3.11 and 3.15, the floor requires-python sets and the newest the classifiers name (measured 2026-11-14). https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/src/seed_scan/cli.py
crypto_used_network_justification: Every connection is encrypted unless the user names a loopback node. The Electrum servers of scan and forks are reached over TLS alone. The Ethereum node is reached over https, and over plain http only at a host written as a loopback IP address, such as 127.0.0.1 or [::1]: seed_scan.evm refuses http to any other host, a name such as localhost included. No server or node is asked unless the user names it. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/src/seed_scan/evm.py
crypto_verification_private_justificatio: The certificate is verified in the TLS handshake, before any request is sent, so the addresses asked, which tie a wallet's accounts together, travel only after it. seed-scan sends no cookie or other credential. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/src/seed_scan/evm.py
crypto_weaknesses_justification: No SHA-1 or MD5 appears under src/: hashlib is called for sha256 alone, and CPython's default TLS context excludes SHA-1 cipher suites. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/src/seed_scan/
crypto_working_justification: no broken cryptographic algorithms: SHA-256 and TLS 1.2 or later
dco_justification: main requires the lint / Sign-off check, which refuses a pull request with a commit that lacks its author's Signed-off-by: trailer. Dependabot's, pre-commit.ci's and claude[bot]'s commits are exempt. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/.github/scripts/check_sign_off.py
delivery_mitm_justification: Distribution channels use HTTPS exclusively: the source on GitHub, and releases through PyPI by Trusted Publishing and GitHub Releases. [osps_br_03_02]
delivery_unsigned_justification: The source and the releases are delivered over HTTPS only, through GitHub and PyPI. No package or hash is fetched over plain HTTP. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/releases
dependency_monitoring_justification: Dependabot version updates cover uv and github-actions, Dependabot security updates are on, and the required lint check runs uv audit over the whole uv.lock on every pull request once it is out of draft and every push to main. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/.github/dependabot.yml
description_good_justification: seed-scan is a command for somebody who holds a mnemonic and does not know what it is: which scheme it follows, which addresses it gave, which coins those addresses held, and whether a fork concerns them. It finds funds; the user's own wallet moves them. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/README.md
discussion_justification: GitHub supports discussions on issues and pull requests.
documentation_achievements_justification: README.md links the OpenSSF Scorecard, Best Practices and Baseline badges on the lines the organization standard reserves for them. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/README.md
documentation_architecture_justification: README.md's *What touches the secret* gives the commands and how they relate: identify reads the secret and writes a public bundle; scan reads the bundle and asks the Electrum server and the Ethereum node the user names; forks reads it and asks the Electrum server of a chain forked from Bitcoin; report reads the bundle and scan's result offline. seed_scan.bundle, seed_scan.scan, seed_scan.forks and seed_scan.report document the formats passed between them, and CONTRIBUTING.md's *The public surface* the import rules tests/imports_test.py holds. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/README.md#what-touches-the-secret
documentation_basics_justification: README.md says what the command does, how to run identify, scan, forks and report, and how to use it securely (*What touches the secret*, and SECURITY.md's limitations), but not how to install it: no release exists, and neither README.md nor CONTRIBUTING.md gives a user an install command. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/README.md
documentation_current_justification: The docs build is gated in CI as a required check (docs.yml, `-n -W`), tests/docs_test.py fails when a shipped module has no API page, and tests/readme_test.py runs every Python block of README.md, so neither the reference generated from the docstrings nor the README's example can drift from the code. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/.github/workflows/docs.yml
documentation_interface_justification: Every public module and function carries a docstring, gated by ruff's pydocstyle rules and pydoclint, and docs/source's automodule pages render them into the API reference published at https://seed-scan.readthedocs.io/; tests/docs_test.py fails when a shipped module is missing from them. seed-scan --help and each command's --help give the options.
documentation_quick_start_justification: README.md's *Identifying a mnemonic*, *Scanning a bundle*, *Reading a fork of Bitcoin* and *Reporting what was found* give the first use, one command each, and say what each reads and writes. The commands run once the package is installed, which README.md does not yet say how to do: no release exists. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/README.md#identifying-a-mnemonic
documentation_roadmap_justification: ROADMAP.md, organization-wide in btclib-org/.github, is reviewed every September, states what is maintained, what is intended and what is deliberately not, and names seed-scan. This repository's README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md link it. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/ROADMAP.md
documentation_security_justification: SECURITY.md's *What belongs here* states what the user can expect, the split README.md's *What touches the secret* describes, and its *Limitations, not vulnerabilities* what the user cannot: the package cannot make the machine safe, secret material is not zeroized, nothing is constant-time, and the Electrum server is trusted for what it answers. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/SECURITY.md#limitations-not-vulnerabilities
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: The package itself carries no assertion to enable: git grep -w assert -- src/ finds none, its checks being refusals raised as SeedScanTypeError or SeedScanValueError. The suite's own asserts run, pytest running Python without -O, but those are the tests'. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/src/seed_scan/
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No vulnerability found by dynamic analysis is open: the suite, the only dynamic analysis run here, has found none, and no open issue reports one. No fuzzer or mutation run exists yet (btclib-org/.github#2236). https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/issues
dynamic_analysis_justification: The suite, gated at 100% line and branch coverage, runs on every pull request once it is out of draft and changes more than prose, as test.yml's changes job decides, and release.yml's publish jobs need test.yml's run to pass before a release is uploaded. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: This tree ships pure Python, a memory-safe language; it produces no software written in a memory-unsafe language for a dynamic memory-safety tool to run against. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/pyproject.toml
enhancement_responses_justification: The repository opened on 2026-11-12, and every enhancement request in it is the maintainer's own, so none from anybody else waits for an answer. Read with gh issue list -R btclib-org/seed-scan -s all -L 500 --json author -q '[.[] | select(.author.login != "fametrano")] | length'. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/issues
external_dependencies_justification: pyproject.toml declares the runtime dependencies, bip39-slip39, bip32-descriptors, btclib-wallet, coin-addresses and btclib, each with a lower bound, and the test and tooling dependencies in its dependency-groups, all resolved and pinned in the committed uv.lock. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/pyproject.toml
floss_license_justification: The MIT license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).
floss_license_osi_justification: The MIT license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).
governance_justification: GOVERNANCE.md, organization-wide in btclib-org/.github, documents the decision model and every role a contributor, reviewer or owner holds; this tree's README.md links it. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md
hardened_site_justification: Not every project site sends the four headers. The documentation site https://seed-scan.readthedocs.io/ is served by Read the Docs with Strict-Transport-Security and X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, and no Content-Security-Policy or X-Frame-Options. The project page https://btclib.org/seed-scan/ answers 404, with Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, X-Frame-Options DENY and X-Content-Type-Options nosniff. The repository on github.com sends all four. Nothing is on PyPI yet. Measured with curl -sIL on 2026-11-14.
hardening_justification: identify and report add an audit hook that refuses every socket and every new process before they read anything, and refuse to run where the hook is not in place, so that a defect in the package or a dependency cannot send the mnemonic or the bundle anywhere. scan and forks verify certificates with TLS 1.2 at least, bound every answer they read, and refuse plain http but at a host written as a loopback IP address. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/src/seed_scan/cli.py
implement_secure_design_justification: The design keeps the secret on one machine: identify reads it and opens no connection, scan and forks read only public data, and report reads them offline (README.md's *What touches the secret*). Defaults fail safe: no server or node is asked unless the user names it, certificates are verified, plain http is refused but at a host written as a loopback IP address, forks refuses a server whose blocks at the chain's checkpoints are another chain's, and a bundle or scan result of another format or version is refused. An audit hook mediates every socket and process in identify and report. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/README.md#what-touches-the-secret
input_validation_justification: Every input from outside is checked against its format and refused otherwise, with a SeedScanTypeError or SeedScanValueError: seed_scan.bundle.loads and seed_scan.scan.loads refuse text that is not JSON, another format or version, a missing member or one of the wrong type, and hold each text member to the values the format defines; seed_scan.evm refuses a node answer that is not a JSON-RPC 2.0 response or a bounded quantity, and the server is parsed as host:port. tests/scan_loads_test.py, tests/bundle_test.py and tests/evm_test.py hold them; a test driving the rule over every public function is owed by btclib-org/seed-scan#3. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#the-public-surface
installation_common_justification: pip installs it from the git URL and uninstalls it, the convention a Python package follows: pip install git+https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan, then pip uninstall seed-scan, measured on 1e9a060 on 2026-11-14. test.yml's dist job builds the wheel and installs it with uv pip install on every pull request once it is out of draft and changes more than prose, and on every push to main, as it did for 1e9a060. Nothing is on PyPI yet: no release exists. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/actions/runs/43593264940/job/132442320424
installation_development_quick_justifica: `uv sync` installs the whole development environment in one command, uv being the only tool to install first; CONTRIBUTING.md's *The environment and the gates* gives it beside `uv run pytest` and the lint gate. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#the-environment-and-the-gates
installation_standard_variables_justific: Installation is pip's, which follows pip's and the interpreter's own install-location conventions; there is no project-specific installer that could diverge from that convention. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/pyproject.toml
interact_justification: README.md, the repository front page, says what the command does and links the releases, SECURITY.md and CONTRIBUTING.md, which says where an issue is filed. The home page https://btclib.org/seed-scan/ answers 404. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan
interfaces_current_justification: ruff's UP and FA rules flag deprecated constructs, and pytest turns every warning into an error. deps-latest and deps-oldest run the suite weekly at the newest and the floor versions. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/pyproject.toml
internationalization_justification: The prompts, the summaries and the report are English text written in the code, with no message catalogue, so they cannot be localized without changing the code. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/src/seed_scan/report.py
know_common_errors_justification: SECURITY.md's *What belongs here* lists the errors that matter here and the code counters each: a secret reaching an output, a log, an error message or the network (hidden prompt, refusals that quote nothing, tests/no_secret_test.py), a secret read from an argument (read from the terminal alone), a connection or a process in identify or report (an audit hook refusing both), and a query to a server the user did not name (none is asked by default). https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/SECURITY.md#what-belongs-here
know_secure_design_justification: The primary developer designed the split README.md's *What touches the secret* describes, which keeps the secret on one machine and gives each command the least it needs, with fail-safe defaults and an audit hook mediating every socket and process. No security review of it has been done yet. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/README.md#what-touches-the-secret
license_location_justification: Non-trivial license location file in repository: <https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/LICENSE>.
license_per_file_justification: Every Python file states "Distributed under the MIT software license, see the accompanying LICENSE file or https://opensource.org/license/mit", e.g. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/src/seed_scan/__init__.py
maintained_justification: The repository opened on 2026-11-12, and pull requests have merged on each day since, listed with gh pr list -R btclib-org/seed-scan -s merged -B main -L 500 --json mergedAt. seed-scan has no release yet: gh release list -R btclib-org/seed-scan prints nothing. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged
maintenance_or_update_justification: seed-scan has no release yet: gh release list -R btclib-org/seed-scan prints nothing. There is no older version to maintain or upgrade from. SECURITY.md says only the latest release will be supported, and RELEASE_NOTES.md is where a release says what a user must act on to upgrade. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supported-versions
no_leaked_credentials_justification: detect-secrets baseline gated by pre-commit, and GitHub secret scanning with push protection enabled on the repository: https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/.secrets.baseline
osps_ac_01_01_justification: The btclib-org organization requires two-factor authentication of every member and accepts only secure methods, not SMS. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/issues/1362#issuecomment-5903994882
osps_ac_02_01_justification: A new member gets read access, the organization's base permission (gh api orgs/btclib-org --jq .default_repository_permission). Every higher grant is assigned by hand, through an issue in btclib-org/.github that an owner other than the one asking approves. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#how-a-decision-is-made
osps_ac_03_01_justification: The main-self-merge ruleset requires a pull request for every change to main. Its one bypass actor, fametrano, holds it in pull_request mode, which excuses the approval but still refuses a direct push, so nobody pushes to main directly. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/issues/2021
osps_ac_03_02_justification: The main-integrity ruleset forbids deleting main and has no bypass actor. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#branch-protection-and-rulesets
osps_ac_04_01_justification: The default GITHUB_TOKEN is read-only at the organization and the repository, and cannot approve pull requests. Every workflow also sets permissions: contents: read at the top. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#tokens-publishing-scanning
osps_ac_04_02_justification: Every workflow sets permissions: contents: read at the top, and a job adds a write scope only where it uses it. zizmor's excessive-permissions audit runs in the required lint check. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#what-every-workflow-does
osps_br_01_01_justification: No workflow uses pull_request_target or workflow_run. Event fields and inputs reach run: steps only through env:, and zizmor's template-injection audit in the required lint check refuses the unsafe form. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml
osps_br_01_03_justification: Pull-request runs use the pull_request and pull_request_review_comment triggers, which give a fork no secrets and a read-only token. The review job, which holds a secret, runs only when the head repository is this one. The mention job holds a secret on any pull request's issue comment, and there checks out the default branch. It answers only a comment whose author is an owner, a member or a collaborator, and its tools exclude Bash, edits, writes, file reads and every tool that runs code. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/.github/workflows/reusable-claude-review.yml
osps_br_01_04_justification: The only workflow_dispatch inputs are verified-signatures.yml's before and after, which the called workflow reads through env: and refuses unless they are commit shas. A release tag's name is checked against the package version before anything is built. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/.github/workflows/verified-signatures.yml
osps_br_02_01_justification: seed-scan has no release yet: gh release list -R btclib-org/seed-scan prints nothing. Each release is to carry a unique calendar version (YYYY.M.D), set by a signed v* tag; release.yml refuses a tag that disagrees with the package version or is not on main, and PyPI never accepts a version twice. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml
osps_br_02_02_justification: seed-scan has no release yet: gh release list -R btclib-org/seed-scan prints nothing. osps_br_03_01_justification: Every official channel the project lists is served over HTTPS only: the GitHub repository, its issue tracker and advisories, the documentation at https://seed-scan.readthedocs.io/, and the home page https://btclib.org/seed-scan/, which answers 404 for now.
osps_br_03_02_justification: The distribution channels README.md lists, PyPI and GitHub Releases, are HTTPS only, and releases are to carry PEP 740 attestations on PyPI and a Sigstore bundle on GitHub. Nothing has been distributed yet. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/releases
osps_br_04_01_justification: seed-scan has no release yet: gh release list -R btclib-org/seed-scan prints nothing. The GitHub release body is to be RELEASE_NOTES.md's entry: what a user must act on, breaking and security changes included; CHANGELOG.md is to list every change. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/RELEASE_NOTES.md
osps_br_05_01_justification: Python dependencies come from PyPI, and the required test check runs the suite with uv from the committed uv.lock with --locked. pre-commit installs its hooks at the revisions .pre-commit-config.yaml names. Third-party actions are pinned by commit SHA. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#uvlock
osps_br_06_01_justification: seed-scan has no release yet: gh release list -R btclib-org/seed-scan prints nothing. Each PyPI file is to carry a PEP 740 attestation from Trusted Publishing, and the GitHub release a Sigstore build-provenance bundle over each asset's SHA-256; the tag is to be signed. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml
osps_br_07_01_justification: Secret scanning and push protection are on, so a push carrying a recognised credential is refused. The detect-private-key and detect-secrets hooks run in the required lint check. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/.secrets.baseline
osps_br_07_02_justification: A secret is an environment secret that only the owners reach. A secret kept in any other store is recorded in the REPOSITORY.md of the repository that uses it, and btclib-org/.github's tests/secrets_test.py refuses an unrecorded one. A secret is rotated when an owner changes or an exposure is suspected. The secrets kept outside an environment are rotated before they are a year old, and the list is reviewed yearly. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#tokens-publishing-scanning
osps_do_01_01_justification: The user documentation is README.md, which gives identify, scan, forks and report, what each reads and writes and what touches the secret, each command's --help, and the API reference on Read the Docs. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/README.md#identifying-a-mnemonic https://seed-scan.readthedocs.io/
osps_do_02_01_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md says where a defect is filed, and the bug-report form asks for what a report needs. SECURITY.md sends a vulnerability to a private channel instead. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml
osps_do_03_01_justification: SECURITY.md gives the gh attestation verify command for the release assets, and RELEASING.md the check that rebuilds the sdist from its tag. osps_do_03_02_justification: The verify command pins the signer and the source: --owner btclib-org, --signer-workflow the organization's reusable-build.yml and --source-ref the release tag, and it compares the certificate's sourceRepositoryIdentifier with this repository's id, which a rename keeps. osps_do_07_01_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md gives the build: uv is the only prerequisite, uv sync builds the environment from uv.lock, and uv build produces the sdist and wheel. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

osps_gv_02_01_justification: Proposed changes and usage obstacles are discussed publicly in the repository's GitHub issues (with a question form) and pull requests; cross-repository questions go to btclib-org/.github's tracker. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/issues

osps_gv_03_02_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md states what a contribution must meet: one subject, a Signed-off-by trailer on every commit, the gates CI runs, 100% line and branch coverage, and a review against REVIEWING.md. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
osps_gv_04_01_justification: A grant of write or admin, to any repository of the organization, is an issue in btclib-org/.github that states the reason, and an owner other than the one asking approves it there. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#how-a-decision-is-made

osps_qa_02_01_justification: pyproject.toml declares the direct dependencies, the runtime ones in dependencies and the development tools in dependency groups, and the committed uv.lock pins them. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/pyproject.toml

osps_qa_04_01_justification: README.md names the packages the command builds on, each its own repository, and the organization standard's section 2 (*Which repositories, and how far*) lists every repository of btclib-org and its tier. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#which-repositories-and-how-far

osps_qa_06_03_justification: The policy is 100% line and branch coverage (CONTRIBUTING.md, standard section 8). pyproject.toml sets fail_under = 100, so untested new code fails the required test check. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/pyproject.toml
osps_qa_07_01_justification: The main-self-merge ruleset requires one approving review from somebody other than the author before a merge to main, and dismisses an approval on a new push. osps_sa_01_01_justification: README.md's *What touches the secret* names the actors, the user, identify, scan with the server and the node the user names, forks with the server of the forked chain the user names, and report, and what each reads, writes and asks. osps_sa_03_01_justification: seed-scan has no release yet: gh release list -R btclib-org/seed-scan prints nothing. osps_vm_01_01_justification: SECURITY.md's *Reporting a vulnerability* gives the private channels, a GitHub security advisory or email, and the timeframes: a report is acknowledged within 7 days, and a fix or a published advisory follows within 90 days. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability
osps_vm_02_01_justification: SECURITY.md names the security contacts: a private GitHub security advisory, or email to security at btclib dot org. btclib-org/.github's GOVERNANCE.md, *Roles*, says that address reaches every organization owner. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles

osps_vm_04_01_justification: Vulnerabilities are published as GitHub security advisories on this repository, each naming the release that fixes it. None has been published yet. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/security/advisories
osps_vm_04_02_justification: The CycloneDX SBOM a release attaches lists, in its vulnerabilities array, every vulnerability that the tree's .github/vex.toml judges not to affect the release, with the reason. osps_vm_05_01_justification: The standard sets the threshold: actions/dependency-review-action fails a pull request that adds or changes a dependency with an advisory of moderate severity or above, or with a licence outside the allow-list. osps_vm_05_02_justification: release.yml runs uv audit over every dependency the wheel declares, and every publish job needs it to succeed. An advisory, or a service it cannot reach, stops the release. The only exemption is an id that the tree's own .github/vex.toml, carried into the release's signed SBOM, states as not affecting it. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#12-releasing
osps_vm_05_03_justification: The required lint check audits the whole uv.lock, every dependency group, on every pull request once it is out of draft: check_audit.py --all-groups runs uv audit, which reads OSV's malicious-package (MAL-) entries as well as advisories. The required Dependency review check also blocks a change that adds a dependency with an advisory of moderate severity or above, or a licence outside the allow-list. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#12-releasing https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#tokens-publishing-scanning
osps_vm_06_01_justification: The standard's section 5 sets a threshold of zero for ruff: select = ALL, bandit's S rules included, and each finding is fixed or suppressed in place with a reason. zizmor holds workflows to the same, in the required lint check. osps_vm_06_02_justification: The required lint check runs .pre-commit-config.yaml on every pull request once it is out of draft (ruff with the S rules, strict mypy, zizmor, detect-secrets) and blocks the merge on any finding not suppressed in place with a reason. test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md makes 100% coverage a gate every change to code must pass, so new functionality comes with its tests. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#the-environment-and-the-gates
test_policy_mandated_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md requires 100% line and branch coverage, and fail_under = 100.0 fails the CI gate on any new code without a test. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#the-environment-and-the-gates
test_statement_coverage80_justification: pyproject.toml sets fail_under = 100.0, and test.yml's coverage job gates it on every pull request once it is out of draft and changes more than prose. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/pyproject.toml
test_statement_coverage90_justification: pyproject.toml sets fail_under = 100.0 under [tool.coverage.report], and test.yml's coverage job, under the required check test: every job passed, enforces it on every pull request once it is out of draft and changes more than prose: https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/pyproject.toml
tests_are_added_justification: Each pull request that added a command, identify, scan, the Ethereum scan, report and forks, changed files under tests/ beside src/, listed with gh pr list -R btclib-org/seed-scan -s merged -B main -L 500 -S 'merged:<=2026-11-14T12:07:34Z' --json number,files -q '.[] | select(any(.files[]; .path | startswith("src/"))) | [.number, ([.files[].path | select(startswith("tests/"))] | length)]'. The required check test: every job passed fails any pull request that leaves a line or branch untested. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged
tests_documented_added_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md documents the 100% coverage gate, so new functionality is not accepted without a test. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
two_person_review_justification: seed-scan has no release yet: gh release list -R btclib-org/seed-scan prints nothing. Of the pull requests merged up to 2026-11-14T12:07:34Z, when 1e9a060 landed, 1 of 14 was approved by somebody other than its author: Dependabot's, approved by fametrano. Counted with gh pr list -R btclib-org/seed-scan -s merged -B main -L 500 -S 'merged:<=2026-11-14T12:07:34Z' --json author,reviews -q '[.[] | .author.login as $a | select(any(.reviews[]; .state == "APPROVED" and .author.login != $a))] | length', and the total with --json number -q length. main's ruleset requires one approving review from somebody other than the author, and fametrano holds a pull_request-mode bypass of it, read with gh api repos/btclib-org/seed-scan/rulesets/27150818 --jq '.bypass_actors, .rules'. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/issues/2021
updateable_reused_components_justificati: The reused components are PyPI packages: pyproject.toml declares the runtime ones with lower bounds, uv.lock pins every one, Dependabot bumps them, and the deps-latest sentinel runs the full suite against the upgraded set every week. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/.github/workflows/deps-latest.yml
version_semver_justification: CalVer, YYYY.M.D, declared in pyproject.toml and explained in RELEASE_NOTES.md: the number says when a release was cut and promises nothing about compatibility, so a breaking change is announced in RELEASE_NOTES.md. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/RELEASE_NOTES.md
version_tags_justification: seed-scan has no release yet: gh release list -R btclib-org/seed-scan prints nothing. No release is tagged yet; RELEASING.md tags each release v<version> on the release commit. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/tags
version_tags_signed_justification: seed-scan has no release yet: gh release list -R btclib-org/seed-scan prints nothing. No tag exists, so none is signed. The tag-integrity ruleset requires a signature on every v* tag, and RELEASING.md reads each signature back. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/REPOSITORY.md#tag-protection
version_unique_justification: seed-scan has no release yet: gh release list -R btclib-org/seed-scan prints nothing. No release has a version yet. Each is to carry a unique calendar version, YYYY.M.D, declared once in pyproject.toml and tagged v<version>, and release.yml refuses a tag that disagrees with it. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/pyproject.toml
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No vulnerability in this code is known and none is unfixed: the advisories list is empty and no Dependabot alert is open. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/security/advisories
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No vulnerability in this code has been reported or published, and no Dependabot alert is open. Issue 10, labelled security, is GHSA-mmhr-3c5m-f64f in soupsieve, which only the docs group locks, through furo; pull request 11 moved the lock past it on 2026-11-13, the day it was filed. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/security/advisories
vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: No vulnerability in this code has been reported to this repository, so there is no reporter to credit. SECURITY.md says how a report is made. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability report has been received since the repository opened on 2026-11-12. SECURITY.md promises an acknowledgement within 7 days. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/security/advisories
vulnerability_response_process_justifica: SECURITY.md's *Reporting a vulnerability* gives the private channels (a GitHub security advisory, or security at btclib dot org), who can see a report, how a CVE is requested and the timeframes. Private vulnerability reporting is enabled. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability
warnings_fixed_justification: Warnings are not tolerated: ruff, strict mypy and pytest's filterwarnings = ["error"] fail the required checks. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/pyproject.toml
warnings_justification: mypy strict with all relevant extra checks activated, see https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/pyproject.toml
warnings_strict_justification: ruff runs with `select = ["ALL"]` (every rule family) and mypy runs with `strict = true`; both are zero-finding pre-commit hooks enforced again by the required lint workflow. https://github.com/btclib-org/seed-scan/blob/main/pyproject.toml
